name: Camp Curiosity
description_short: Traditional day camp for ages 2 to 14 on a 50 acre campus in Doylestown with two pools, a stocked pond, creek and woods. Older campers get daily swim lessons and free swim plus art, sports, archery, fishing, boating and golf; preschool groups have water play and rest time.
refund_policy_summary: The $100 registration fee is nonrefundable. The deposit is refundable if you withdraw by email before June 1; changes after May 1 cost $50 per week per change.
notes: 2027 weekly rates: $615 until January 31, $655 until April 30, $695 from May 1 or for a single week, plus a $100 registration fee; two weeks recommended. 5% discounts for siblings, service members, first responders and teachers, and 5+ weeks (stack up to 10%). Camp 9:00 to 4:00 with drop off from 8:00 and pick up until 5:00. Groups: Trekkers (2), Rovers (3), Mavericks (4), Pioneers (entering K), grades 1 to 6; CIT program for grades 7 to 9 at $575 a week, four week minimum. Lunch and snacks packed or bought; soft pretzels Wednesdays and water ice Fridays included.
